items.title: Rufus Reid interviewed by Monk Rowe, Atlanta, GA, January 4, 2013
items.q: Matt Wilson had a wonderful workshop yesterday and I advocated also...

ctx.x: If there’s something that makes a person, a listener, turn his head and go oh, what was that.

Right. Exactly. And the element of surprise. Matt Wilson had a wonderful workshop yesterday and I advocated also, we have such history now of playing music that is jazz, and we play the head. And then we take solos. And then we take fours. And then the drums do this. So now everybody does it that way. And then we wonder how come audiences are going to sleep. Because it’s all predictable. So the element of surprise — it doesn’t have to be a huge surprise, it just has to be something that’s not predictable. So…
Well said. Let me run a couple of names by you and see if they strike you as, what did you learn from them or learn not to do, or anything in particular. Dexter Gordon?
